war_summary: On Day 119 of War 139, high-tempo combat and frequent strategic base exchanges remain concentrated across volatile island fronts and contested central-eastern regions. Endless Shore continues as the primary operational hotspot with severe casualties and ongoing base flips, while Stema Landing, Godcrofts, and Onyx experience active contestation and recent ownership turnover. Meanwhile, Clahstra and Marban Hollow are sustaining massive, accelerating casualty rates across their contested frontlines, alongside substantial recent volatility in Oarbreaker.
